z-m-16-01.title: Ingaba yintetho enika inani eliphambili nokuba ubeka nelinye inani ku-n?
z-m-16-01.topic: Amanani aphambili namanani axubileyo, amaxabiso eentetho ezinoonobumba
z-m-16-01.goal: Funda ukuba ukulunga amaxesha amaninzi akuqinisekisi 'rhoqo,' lungisa ukuqiniseka kwakho ukuze kuhambelane nedatha, uze ufumane umzekelo ochasayo wena.
z-m-16-01.material: Umhlobo weklabhu yemathematika wathi, "Xa n yi-integer engu-0 okanye ngaphezulu, njenge-0, 1, 2, ..., ixabiso le-n×n+n+41 (n amaxesha n kudityaniswe n kudityaniswe 41) rhoqo linani eliphambili!" Inani eliphambili linani eliyi-2 ubuncinane elinabahluli bayo kuphela yi-1 nalo ngokwalo, kwaye inani eliyi-2 ubuncinane elingelona eliphambili linani elixubileyo.
z-m-16-01.thinking.0: Ukwahlula inani lamatyala ajongiweyo kwi 'onke amatyala'
z-m-16-01.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yamanani aphambili namaxubileyo (inani eliphambili linani eliyi-2 ubuncinane elinabahluli bayo kuphela yi-1 nalo ngokwalo)
z-m-16-01.prereq.1: Ukubeka inani endaweni yonobumba n ukufumana ixabiso lentetho (n×n yi-n isikwere)
z-m-16-01.prereq.2: Ukubala ngokwahlula amanani anamanani ukuya kwamane ngamanani amancinci ngolandelelwano

z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucinga ntoni ngoku ngesibhengezo somhlobo wakho?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukujonga kahlanu ngumkhondo oxhasa isibhengezo. Kodwa ii-n zingapheliyo, ngoko ukuthi 'rhoqo,' ufuna ukuvavanya ngakumbi okanye ufumane isizathu.

z-m-16-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba iquka inqaku lokuba 'ndihlolile ezininzi' no'ndihlolile yonke imeko' ziyahluka?
z-m-16-01.s.s3.model.0: Kwi-n=40, i-1681=41×41, ngoko ayiyontloko. Nokuba amaxabiso angama-40 ayeyintloko, ukuba kuphuma n e-1 enjalo, 'ihlala iyintloko' iba ngeyiyonyaniso.

z-m-16-02.title: Xa iibhasi ezi-2 zihamba kunye okokuqala okulandelayo

Namhlanje ngentsimbi ye-9 a.m. kanye iibhasi ezi-2 zihambe kunye, yaye emva koko indlela nganye igcina ixesha layo ngqo ize iqhubeke ihamba.
